system.description:
ATTACK ESSENCE INVOCATION SHAMAN SPIRIT
Shaman Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 60 feet
Targets 1 disembodied spirit, incorporeal Undead, directly targetable haunt or possessing entity that you can perceive
Base Damage 1d6

You lash a spirit with a violent pulse of resonance.
On a successful spell attack, the target suffers 2d6 essence damage.
If the target is currently possessing another creature, Spirit Rebuke damages the possessing entity rather than its host.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Increase the damage by 1d6 (max 10d6).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. A spell attack for essence damage; the book's Base Damage line (1d6) and text (2d6) disagree — 2d6 is shipped, flagged for Graham.
